## Issue summary

XLSX reader returns empty cells when the cell is part of a merged range. Steps: open `merged.xlsx`, expect cell A2 to contain 'Header', got empty string. The merged-anchor cell resolves correctly but every non-anchor cell in the merge returns None.

## Files touched

```
src/converters/xlsx_converter.py
tests/test_xlsx_converter.py
```

## Diff

```diff
diff --git a/src/converters/xlsx_converter.py b/src/converters/xlsx_converter.py
--- a/src/converters/xlsx_converter.py
+++ b/src/converters/xlsx_converter.py
@@ -138,6 +138,12 @@ class XlsxConverter:
     def _read_cell(self, cell):
         if cell.value is None:
+            # Phase 5.1: cells inside a merged range return None for non-anchor
+            # positions. Resolve to the anchor cell before reading.
+            anchor = self._merged_anchor_for(cell)
+            if anchor is not None:
+                return anchor.value
             return ''
         return str(cell.value)

diff --git a/tests/test_xlsx_converter.py b/tests/test_xlsx_converter.py
--- a/tests/test_xlsx_converter.py
+++ b/tests/test_xlsx_converter.py
@@ -89,3 +89,16 @@ def test_basic_cell_read():
     assert converter.read('A1') == 'Hello'
+
+def test_merged_range_header_returns_anchor_value():
+    """Regression for merged-anchor bug."""
+    wb = load_fixture('merged.xlsx')
+    converter = XlsxConverter(wb)
+    assert converter.read('A2') == 'Header'
+    assert converter.read('B2') == 'Header'
```
